title: Simple Hammers
description: A Mod adding simple hammers for easy tunneling to the game.
body:
# Simple Hammers

This Mod adds simple and easy to use Hammer tools, that allow you to dig tunnels, rooms, etc. much easier and quicker.

**Dependencies:** None
</br>
**Languages:** English (en_us), German (de_de) _(You can easily add any other language with a texture pack)_

---

</br>

**They dig in a 3x3 are, clearing out blocks much quicker.**

![3x3 Mining Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0940455c4a440f79f6729e60e8215d09499ac4e8.gif)

</br></br>

**Hammers work for every direction, depending on what face of the block you're looking at.**

![Directions Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/560fdbf873c16aafa7ad2f245733905d694e33e3.gif)

</br></br>

Were you ever annoyed by gravel or dirt while digging underground?
**Well, no more! Hammers are equally suited to mining stone blocks, ores, dirt, sand and gravel.**

![Gravel Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eb1ebeb1191b9bf89302aae708ca96556f496292.gif)

---

</br>

**One Hammer for every Material Type**

![Hammer Variants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c9aa5501d912b174188663c540bbc57ea4e6ccf.png)

---

</br>

**Crafting Recipes**
<details>
<summary>Wooden Hammer</summary>

![Wooden Hammer Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c19e91f49fdd22bbe3306b2c284651c690bf5395_0.webp)

Works with any item tagged "#minecraft:wooden_tool_materials", like for example OAK_PLANKS.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Golden Hammer</summary>

![Golden Hammer Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8f8e7e7a687d9c84139959e4999db5aaadfb5f47.png)

Works with any item tagged "#minecraft:gold_tool_materials", like for example GOLD_INGOT.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Stone Hammer</summary>

![Stone Hammer Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/54ef84817ffc9ef993b0455d0d51244d26fe26c5_0.webp)

Works with any item tagged "#minecraft:stone_tool_materials", like for example COBBLESTONE or BLACKSTONE.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Copper Hammer</summary>

![Copper Hammer Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/270f1d7ff98bb1f587039b8ad2092bfdd3aa4a9d.png)

Works with any item tagged "#minecraft:copper_tool_materials", like for example COPPER_INGOT.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Iron Hammer</summary>

![Iron Hammer Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a335a63b40d29e3a1646dcbdbbf4d9975e1f2e61_0.webp)

Works with any item tagged "#minecraft:iron_tool_materials", like for example IRON_INGOT.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Diamond Hammer</summary>

![Diamond Hammer Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/009ed1b49e2efde61bd5b74144bb95a2f9950f5f.png)

Works with any item tagged "#minecraft:diamond_tool_materials", like for example DIAMOND.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Netherite Hammer</summary>

![Netherite Hammer Upgrading](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b3fb3a9914bd19ab9f754364b51e80665b1049e5_0.webp)

Works by upgrading a Diamond Hammer on the Smithing Table.

</details>
